sections.title: Inputs And Centerline
sections.text: waypoints required array of at least two [x,y,z] length-expression points. interpolation spline (default, Catmull-Rom interpolating every waypoint) or polyline. endTangents optional {start:[dx,dy,dz],end:[dx,dy,dz]} requested tangents reported against the computed tangent. up optional transport-frame reference direction default [0,0,1]. bendConstraints optional {minRadius}. twist optional angle. obstacles optional {point:[...]} array with minimumClearance. normalSections optional {station} array. section optional native profile for a sweep via existing shape.route path mode (not generated). schemaVersion required 1. The centerline is numerically solved and interpolates inflections; bend radius is the local circumradius, so no unstable Frenet frame is used.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'route.create3d',status,success,documentIdentity,units:{length:'cm',angle:'rad'},frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,centerline:[xyz],interpolation,arcLength,minBendRadius,normalSections:[{station,position}],frames:[{position,tangent,normal,binormal}],selfClearance,clearances,endTangents,routeState,state,twist}. state is set when endTangents were supplied, otherwise numerically-solved. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: Spatial S-Curve Route
examples.requires: Open Design document; three non-collinear 3D waypoints with an inflection.
examples.output: result.arcLength is the sampled neutral-axis length in cm and result.minBendRadius is finite; result.frames use the declared up vector.

sections.title: Inputs And Inspection
sections.text: waypoints or centerline required (exclusive); waypoints use interpolation spline (default) or polyline, centerline is an explicit array of sample points. up optional transport direction default [0,0,1]. obstacles optional {point:[...]} array with minimumClearance; normalSections optional {station} array. schemaVersion required 1. Bend radius is the local circumradius of sample triples, stable through inflections.

examples.label: Known Quarter-Arc Inspection
examples.requires: Open Design document; three points on a 10 mm-radius quarter circle.
examples.output: result.minBendRadius is approximately 1 cm (the known arc radius).

sections.title: Inputs And Interpretation
sections.text: length required positive neutral-axis length L. allowanceFactor finite >=1.0 default 1.1. serviceTail nonnegative per-end length default 15 mm. serviceTailModeled boolean default false. pieces positive integer default 1. schemaVersion required 1. Cut length follows the explicit interpretation L*allowanceFactor + 2*serviceTail (1.1*L + 2*15 mm default); when serviceTailModeled is true the tail is not added again.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'route.cut-list',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,length,allowanceFactor,serviceTail,serviceTailModeled,pieces,cutLengthPerPiece,totalCutLength,interpretation,warnings}. Lengths are reported in mm. Executor created:[]; read-only. A warning is emitted, and the tail omitted, when serviceTailModeled is true.

examples.label: Explicit 1.1L Plus Two Tails
examples.requires: Open Design document; L is 100 mm with a 10 percent allowance and a 15 mm service tail at each end.
examples.output: result.cutLengthPerPiece is 140 mm (1.1*100 + 2*15) and result.interpretation states the formula.

sections.title: Inputs And Poses
sections.text: length required positive neutral-axis length L, preserved across every pose. pan {min,max} and tilt {min,max} angular ranges, or poses explicit array of {pan,tilt,bendRadius?}. minBendRadius optional declared tightest bend radius. state set, numerically-solved (default) or native-dependent. representation recipe. schemaVersion required 1. The PAN x TILT product is evaluated at the four extremes, not a synchronous diagonal track.

sections.title: Return Contract
sections.text: result={schemaVersion:1,operation:'route.motion-states',status,success,documentIdentity,units,frame,associativity:'snapshot',method,limitations,provenance,states:[{pan,tilt,length,lengthPreserved,requiredBendRadius,fits,state}],length,lengthPreserved,declaredState,minBendRadius,extremeCoverage}. requiredBendRadius is a numerical model of the swept articulation; fits is true when minBendRadius is unset or achievable. Executor created:[]; read-only.

examples.label: All PAN TILT Extremes
examples.requires: Open Design document; the route must bend through the four extreme PAN/TILT corners without exceeding a 5 mm radius.
examples.output: result.states has four rows (the PAN x TILT product) and every state.lengthPreserved is true.
